name: pi-sync
description: Synchronize Pi configuration between THIS MACHINE and a SHARED REPOSITORY.

scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test
scripts.release:check: npm run check && npm audit --omit=dev && npm run pack:check
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:integration
scripts.test:unit: node --experimental-strip-types --test test/commands.test.ts test/conflicts.test.ts test/coordinator.test.ts test/files.test.ts test/git.test.ts test/migration.test.ts test/package-execution.test.ts test/plan.test.ts test/recovery.test.ts test/security.test.ts test/settings.test.ts test/state.test.ts test/transaction.test.ts test/ui.test.ts
